_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `crustify-oracle <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through crustify.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

types.name: git_annotated_commit
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps git_annotated_commit opaque. Internal inspection shows the discriminant selects two ownership variants: real commits own commit/tree and duplicated strings; virtual commits own index and the parents buffer. Pointer members are nullable across the union-like variants and all are released by git_annotated_commit_free.

ptr.note: A duplicated git_commit owned by the real variant and released with git_commit_free; absent for virtual commits.
A git__strdup allocation for real commits and null for virtual commits, released by git__free.
Owned only by the virtual variant and released with git_index_free; absent for real commits.
Optional git__strdup allocation for reference/fetch-head commits, released by git__free.
Optional git__strdup allocation for fetch-head commits, released by git__free.
Lazily populated for a real annotated commit by git_commit_tree and released with git_tree_free; absent for virtual commits.

types.name: git_attr_value_t
types._comment_agent: git_attr_value_t is a fieldless enum with no pointer, lifecycle, refcount, or locking semantics.

types.name: git_blame
types._comment_agent: The public API exposes git_blame only as an opaque, uniquely owned result released by git_blame_free. Internally it owns its duplicated path, optional mailmap and blob, hunk/path vectors, and counted line/index buffers; it borrows the repository. final, ent, final_buf, and current_hunk are transient aliases or work-state pointers and are not published as fields.

ptr.note: Temporary mutable cursor into an owned hunk stored by the hunks vector during git_blame_buffer. It is never independently released.
Head of the mutable, owned scoreboard-entry list during blame_internal. Every entry is released on that routine's success and error exits; the stale field is not subsequently used or published.

Transient alias to the commit adopted by a git_blame__origin. Entry cleanup releases the origin (and commit) before blame_internal returns, so this field is thereafter stale and is never exposed or dereferenced.
Owned blob lookup result, optionally absent during partial construction, released by git_blame_free.
Counted read-only bytes returned by git_blob_rawcontent and kept alive by final_blob; buffer-derived blame objects leave this NULL.
Owned growable array of line-start offsets; storage is allocated by index_blob_lines and cleared by git_blame_free.
Owned growable array of git_blame_line values; elements are initialized by index_blob_lines and storage is cleared by git_blame_free.
Optional mailmap created when GIT_BLAME_USE_MAILMAP is set and released by git_blame_free.
Owned git__strdup path, released by git_blame_free. It may be NULL while git_blame__alloc unwinds a partial construction.
Borrowed repository retained for blame computation and for constructing a derived buffer blame. The caller must keep it alive; libgit2 operations may mutate repository-owned internal state.

types.name: git_branch_iterator
types._comment_agent: Public opaque iterator. Its allocation is uniquely owned and released by git_branch_iterator_free; no fields are published.

types.name: git_branch_t
types._comment_agent: Closed public branch-kind enum with LOCAL and REMOTE values plus the ALL bitwise filter value; it has no pointer or lifecycle fields.

types.name: git_buf
types._comment_agent: Public git_buf owns a counted mutable byte allocation through ptr, except for its NULL initial state and the static empty sentinel. reserved is allocation capacity and size is initialized payload length.

ptr.note: Counted mutable byte buffer owned by git_buf when allocated; empty sanitized buffers may instead point at the static git_str__initstr sentinel. NULL is valid in GIT_BUF_INIT. The size excludes a guaranteed trailing NUL, but interior NUL bytes are allowed, so this is modeled as an array rather than a string. git_buf_dispose handles the owned-vs-static runtime gate.

types.name: git_clone_local_t
types._comment_agent: Closed public C enum with four scalar values and no ownership-bearing fields.

types.name: git_config
types._comment_agent: git_config is refcounted through rc: git_config_new initializes one count, repository storage increments it, and git_config_free decrements it before releasing the object.

types.name: git_describe_format_options
types._comment_agent: Public format options are caller-owned by value and have no lifecycle operation. dirty_suffix is an optional borrowed const C string read synchronously by git_describe__format.

ptr.note: The options struct only borrows this optional NUL-terminated suffix. git_describe__format copies the options by value and reads the string during the formatting call; no path stores, mutates, clones, or frees it. The caller must keep the suffix alive while the options may be used.

types.name: git_describe_options
types._comment_agent: The options struct owns no pointee storage. pattern is an optional borrowed input string whose caller must keep it valid through each describe operation.

ptr.note: Optional caller-owned NUL-terminated match pattern; libgit2 only reads it during describe calls and neither stores a copy nor frees it.

types.name: git_describe_result
types._comment_agent: A describe result owns its optional name/tag variant and borrows its repository. Its public destructor releases the owned variant and result storage but not the repository.

ptr.note: Deep-duplicated exact-match commit_name owned by the result; formatting may lazily populate its tag, and result_free releases its tag, path, and allocation.
Borrowed from the repository owning the input object (or passed to workdir); format uses it but result_free does not release it, so the repository must outlive result use.
Deep-duplicated possible_tag owned by the result; formatting may mutate the nested commit_name, and result_free releases the complete nested allocation.

types.name: git_diff
types._comment_agent: git_diff is publicly opaque but internally refcounted. Its repository slot is a nullable non-owning pointer (parsed diffs leave it null; generated diffs retain a repository borrow). All callback slots are non-owning addresses of static libgit2 functions and are initialized for every fully constructed generated or parsed diff.

ptr.note: Initialized to a static case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison routine.
Initialized to the generated- or parsed-diff static destructor before publication.
Initialized to the generated- or parsed-diff static patch factory before publication.
Initialized to a static case-sensitive or case-insensitive prefix routine.
Generated diffs borrow their repository and use it for later diff/patch operations; parsed diffs store null. The diff destructor does not release the repository.
Initialized to a static libgit2 comparison routine for every fully constructed diff.
Initialized to a static libgit2 comparison routine for every fully constructed diff.

types.name: git_diff_line
types._comment_agent: Inspected every content/content_len assignment, read, and release path. Ownership is runtime-conditional at the containing patch implementation level, so the wrapper exposes a borrowed counted view and does not assume standalone ownership.

ptr.note: Counted, non-NUL-terminated bytes. Parsed-patch lines own separately allocated content which patch_parsed__free releases; generated, apply, print, and xdiff lines borrow parent or callback backing storage. Public observations bind the bytes to the line/containing patch lifetime. Zero-initialized and empty construction paths permit NULL with length zero; the const pointer is never written through.

types.name: git_diff_stats
types._comment_agent: The public type is opaque. Its successful constructor owns one refcounted git_diff handle and one files_changed-length statistics buffer; its public destructor releases both before freeing the header.

ptr.note: git_diff_get_stats stores a non-null git_diff, increments its reference count, and git_diff_stats_free releases that owned count with git_diff_free.

git_diff_get_stats allocates a mutable diff_file_stats array whose element count is files_changed; construction fails if allocation returns null, and git_diff_stats_free releases the buffer with git__free.

types.name: git_error
types._comment_agent: git_error itself has no unconditional lifecycle contract: git_error_last returns libgit2-managed TLS/static storage, while internal git_error_save may allocate a separately freed snapshot. The message field therefore has runtime-conditional owned/borrowed string storage.

ptr.note: Runtime-conditional storage: git_error_save duplicates and owns the NUL-terminated message, the TLS error borrows its containing threadstate's git_str buffer, and static sentinel errors borrow string literals. git_error_free releases only saved non-static objects. Public git_error_last exposes a const borrowed view. NULL is accepted by set_error/restore and free, though ordinary published errors use non-null messages.

types.name: git_index_conflict_iterator
types._comment_agent: The conflict iterator exclusively owns only its allocation and borrows the external index stored in `index`.

ptr.note: The constructor stores its required index argument without retaining it; iteration reads and may sort the index entries, and the public contract forbids modification while iterating, so the index must outlive the iterator.
Consumes and deallocates a malloc-family allocation; C specifies NULL as a no-op. The allocation may hold one object, raw bytes, or a NUL-terminated string.

Consumes an allocation through libgit2's gfree callback; NULL is a no-op. Because git__free reads the mutable global allocator at deallocation time, the installed gfree must remain compatible with the allocator that created a live allocation. The allocation may hold one object, raw bytes, or a NUL-terminated string.
Reads the complete NUL-terminated source string through strlen and memcpy without retaining it. A null or unterminated source is invalid.

Returns null on allocation failure or a fresh, mutable NUL-terminated deep copy allocated through libgit2's current allocator; the caller releases it through git__free while a compatible allocator remains installed.
Consumes and frees a complete annotated commit; NULL is explicitly accepted as a no-op.
Consumes and releases one fully constructed git_blame and all of its owned resources; NULL is explicitly accepted as a no-op.
Consumes the iterator allocation and its nested reference iterator; NULL is explicitly accepted as a no-op.
Borrows the non-null output slot and writes one newly allocated iterator on success; the caller assumes ownership of that iterator.
Borrows the repository for construction only; the resulting reference iterator does not retain the repository pointer, though libgit2 may mutate repository-owned internal state while creating it.
Mutably borrows the iterator for the call and advances its nested reference iterator; ownership remains with the caller.
Borrows the output slot and transfers ownership of one reference into it on success.
Borrows the scalar output slot and writes the yielded branch kind on success.
Borrows and mutates the git_buf header, conditionally frees its owned ptr field, and resets it in place; a NULL header is accepted.
Deprecated alias for git_buf_dispose; borrows the header, disposes its ptr field, and leaves the header reset in place.
Consumes one owned git_config reference; NULL is a no-op. It decrements rc and releases the allocation and backend fields when the final count reaches zero.
Consumes and frees a complete describe result plus its owned name/tag variant; NULL is accepted as a no-op.
Transiently borrows a live diff and atomically increments its embedded reference count, producing another ownership count for the same pointer.
Consumes one git_diff reference count; null is explicitly accepted. The final decrement invokes the concrete diff destructor.
Consumes and frees a git_diff_stats allocation; null is accepted as a no-op.
Consumes and frees the iterator allocation; NULL is explicitly accepted.
